crossRefs.note: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be Yahweh’s glory…
So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was…
Then the Spirit entered into me, and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside…
I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy…
But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on…
Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on…
Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would…
“It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy.…
And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.
After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great…

translations.web: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.
translations.bsb: And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.
translations.kjv: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake
translations.asv: And the Spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet; and I heard him that spake unto me.
